name: Shandong Homey Aquatic Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Homey Aquatic Development Co.,Ltd. operates in marine food industry in China and internationally. It offers quick-frozen prepared food, including meat, vegetable, noodle, and frozen prepared food products; aquatic products comprising sea cucumber, fish, shrimp, shellfish, and other products; and marine food, health products, and pharmaceuticals. The company also provides sea cucumber in various forms, such as salted, ready-to-eat fresh, dried sea cucumber, as well as sea cucumber juice, soft capsules, and oral liquid. It sells its products through e-commerce platforms and TV shopping channels. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Rongcheng, China.
